Commissioners hereby authorizes that the supplemental bridge benefit established pursuant to
Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 8-36-211(i) be paid to each Group 1 member who retires on
a service retirement allowance on or after the attainment of age fifty-five (55), but no later than
age sixty-two (62), with creditable service in a Group 1 position covered by the mandatory
retirement age requirement established pursuant to this resolution and hereby agrees to accept the
associated liability. Members retiring between age fifty-five (55) and sixty (60) shall be paid the
